Lore: Relic Parchment (Consumable)

Can be read to produce the Casting of a Spell, with the reader declaring the Target(s). Doing so costs no Mana, doesn't require a Check, and causes the scroll to vaporize.

Crafting a Spell Scroll requires that the crafter knows the Spell and would be able to perform that Casting of it when crafting it, and can be done with the Study activity.
